build_lexicon_graph: build a graph that transduces letters to word pieces using a lexicon and letter index map
build_token_graph: build a graph with individual token transition models from a list of word pieces
compose_and_project_graphs: compose two graphs and project the output to compute word decomposition paths
compute_alignment_graph: compute an alignment graph by composing token and decomposition graphs with projection
compute_sequence_loss: compute sequence level loss by intersecting emissions with alignment graphs and scoring
